component.title: UndoableDestructiveAction
component.purpose: Make destructive work fast and forgiving by completing the action immediately while keeping a clear, time-bounded recovery path.

states.description: The destructive action is explicit, keyboard-operable, and explains the recovery promise.
The request is in flight and duplicate submission is prevented.
Removal completed with clear closure and a visible recovery surface.
The failure is honest, useful, and recoverable through retry.

claims.statement: A successful destructive action immediately creates a time-bounded undo record with explicit success and failure states.
The recovery surface and retry controls reflow to full-width mobile controls without clipping content.
State is communicated through text, roles, and labels in addition to tone color.
